_comment_purpose: Dataset config template. Copy, rename, and fill all fields. Remove _comment_* keys.
_comment_required_vs_optional: Keys marked REQUIRED must be present. OPTIONAL keys have defaults shown.
name: REQUIRED: short identifier used in run directories and experiment configs, e.g. pems_node1
adapter: REQUIRED: adapter class to use, e.g. 'adapters.regression_csv.RegressionCSVAdapter'
data_path: REQUIRED (regression): path to the CSV file, relative to this config file or absolute
image_dir: REQUIRED (cv): path to image directory or manifest CSV
value_column: REQUIRED (regression): name of the column to predict
seq_length: OPTIONAL (regression): sliding window length in timesteps (default: 5)
train_frac: OPTIONAL: fraction of data used for training (default: 0.8)
val_frac: OPTIONAL: fraction of data used for validation / proxy calibration (default: 0.0)
stream_delay_s: OPTIONAL: seconds to sleep between streaming steps, for real-time simulation (default: 0.0)

model_name_1._comment: Key = model name used in model.csv, ema_scores, and event log
model_name_1.weights_path: REQUIRED: path to weights file (absolute or relative to config)
model_name_1.loader: REQUIRED: dotted module path to a load() function, e.g. 'adapters.loaders.lstm_loader'

min_score: OPTIONAL: minimum acceptable HarmonE score (default from thresholds.json)
max_energy: OPTIONAL: initial energy threshold upper bound (default from thresholds.json)
E_ref: OPTIONAL: reference normalised energy for Eq.3 threshold update (default: 0.7)
delta: OPTIONAL: step size for Eq.3 threshold update (default: 0.1)
beta: OPTIONAL: accuracy weight in score formula (default: 0.95)
alpha: OPTIONAL: S4 harmone_original epsilon-greedy exploration probability, rolled EVERY cycle like the original HarmonE (default: 0.1)
switch_hold_cycles: OPTIONAL: after any model switch, suppress further switches for this many MAPE cycles (original HarmonE recovery_cycles=3). Both harnesses, all planners (default: 0 = off)
explore_prob: OPTIONAL: S5/S6 per-cycle probability of probing the least-recently-observed model, so frozen EMA estimates get refreshed (default: 0.0 = off)
drift_cooldown_rows: OPTIONAL (concurrent harness): after a replace/retrain of a model, suppress drift for that model for this many stream rows; its drift reference is also re-based to the adapted window (default: drift window size)
max_batches_ahead: OPTIONAL (concurrent harness): how many monitor_interval batches inference may run ahead of the manager. 1 = decisions apply exactly one batch later; 0 = lockstep; negative = no barrier (default: 1)
E_m: OPTIONAL: minimum raw energy µJ for normalisation (default: 0)
E_M: OPTIONAL: maximum raw energy µJ for normalisation (CALIBRATE per hardware+dataset)
tau_drift: OPTIONAL: KL divergence threshold for drift detection (CALIBRATE per dataset)
task_adapter: OPTIONAL (cv): dotted class path for the TaskAdapter (default resolved from task)
num_classes: OPTIONAL (cv classification/segmentation): number of output classes
ignore_index: OPTIONAL (cv segmentation): pixel label value to ignore in mIoU (default: 255)
embedding_model: OPTIONAL (cv): model name used ONLY for drift embedding extraction (R4 — pinned regardless of active inference model; default: lightest model in spectrum)
embedding_dim: OPTIONAL (cv): expected embedding vector dimension. Validated on first extraction.
embedding_sample_every: OPTIONAL (cv): extract embedding every N frames (default: 1; set >1 to reduce overhead)
drift_window_size: OPTIONAL (cv): number of embeddings in drift detection window (default: 500)
pseudo_label_threshold: OPTIONAL (cv pseudo_label tactic): minimum confidence for pseudo-label acceptance (default: 0.5)
rollback_if_worse: OPTIONAL (cv): rollback new weights if proxy score drops after retrain (default: true)
planner: OPTIONAL: planner strategy name (default: 'harmone_original'). Options: naive, random_switch, greedy_switch, harmone_original, violation_aware, pareto, bandit
w_acc: OPTIONAL (pareto): accuracy weight in Chebyshev distance (default: 1.0)
w_e: OPTIONAL (pareto): energy weight in Chebyshev distance (default: 1.0)
ema_head_start: OPTIONAL (cv): EMA boost applied after VMR deploy (default: 0.1; set 0 to disable)
_comment_drift_induction: == DRIFT INDUCTION (optional, for experiments with synthetic drift) ==

induced_drift._comment: Remove this block entirely if no drift induction is needed
induced_drift.start_frac: Fraction of stream at which drift begins (e.g. 0.5 = halfway through)
induced_drift.end_frac: Fraction of stream at which drift ends (e.g. 1.0 = until end of stream)

_comment_energy_required: List of required energy backends: ['cpu'] or ['cpu','gpu']. Runs missing a required backend are flagged energy_valid=false.
_comment_splits: == CHRONOLOGICAL SPLIT BOUNDARIES (override train_frac/val_frac with explicit indices) ==
train_end_index: OPTIONAL: absolute row index for end of training split (overrides train_frac)
val_end_index: OPTIONAL: absolute row index for end of validation split (overrides val_frac)
